title: Claims release after a local-snapshot submit landing
goal: `cargo local-workflow release` accepted only `ship`'s local integration ref as proof of landing, so work published through `local-snapshot submit` (Mandate 73's development-main publisher) kept its scope reservation forever. Release now also accepts work contained in the fetched `refs/remotes/origin/main`.

results.tests: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-workflow: 187 passed / 0 failed (new: release_accepts_work_the_publisher_landed_on_fetched_main)
results.live: before the fix, `cargo local-workflow release fury` refused with 'committed work has not passed local integration' although T-FURY-1 and T-FURY-3 were on origin/main (3950119c4, bf6763d19)

limitations: The fetched origin/main is trusted as far as the local integration ref already is: both are local refs a local user can move.
